# vaults.fyi

> REST API for DeFi vault data (APY, TVL, Reputation Score), wallet portfolios and unsigned, ready-to-sign vault transactions across 22 EVM networks (v2, stable), plus Solana, borrow markets and other features in beta/alpha. Also a hosted MCP server and keyless x402 pay-per-request access.

Docs for agents: every page below is plain Markdown (`.md`). Everything in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://docs.vaults.fyi/llms-full.txt) (~94k tokens, condensed core: rules, conventions, errors, recipes with one code language, concepts, plans and a summary of every v2 endpoint with links to the full pages; fits in one model context) or [llms-full-complete.txt](https://docs.vaults.fyi/llms-full-complete.txt) (~268k tokens, every page in full; for search or RAG, not for pasting whole). Facts were checked against the live API on 2026-10-23.

Agent essentials (details: [Rules for agents](https://docs.vaults.fyi/ai-agents/rules-for-agents.md), [API conventions](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/conventions.md)):

- Base URL `https://api.vaults.fyi`. Every path carries its version: `/v2/...` (stable), `/beta/...` and `/alpha/...` (may change). Do not put the version in the base URL: a doubled version prefix returns 404.
- REST auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY` (get a key at https://portal.vaults.fyi/signup). The MCP server `https://mcp.vaults.fyi/mcp` takes the same key as `Authorization: Bearer $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`; `Authorization` on REST is ignored.
- No key on a v2 endpoint returns HTTP 402: an x402 v2 payment challenge (`x402Version: 2`, price in `accepts[].amount`, USDC base units on Base). An invalid key returns 401. Beta, alpha and `/v2/nrt/*` need an API key. `GET /v2/health` is public.
- Vaults: `GET /v2/detailed-vaults` (search, filter, rank), `GET /v2/detailed-vaults/{network}/{vaultId}` (one vault; also `/apy`, `/tvl`), `GET /v2/vaults` (cheap ID list, all networks). History: `GET /v2/historical/{network}/{vaultId}/apy` (also `/tvl`, `/sharePrice`).
- Portfolio: `GET /v2/portfolio/positions/{userAddress}`, `GET /v2/portfolio/idle-assets/{userAddress}`, `GET /v2/portfolio/best-deposit-options/{userAddress}`, `GET /v2/portfolio/best-vault/{userAddress}`.
- Transactions: `GET /v2/transactions/context/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`, then `GET /v2/transactions/{action}/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}?assetAddress=...&amount=...`. `userAddress` comes before `network`. Rewards: `GET /v2/transactions/rewards/context/{userAddress}`, then `GET /v2/transactions/rewards/claim/{userAddress}?claimIds=...&claimIds=...`.
- `network` is a name (`base`, `mainnet`, `arbitrum`) or CAIP-2 (`eip155:8453`), never `ethereum` or a bare chain ID. Take `vaultId` from list responses: it is usually the vault address but can be a non-address ID.
- Units: APY is a decimal fraction net of fees (`0.0551` = 5.51%), read from `apy.<window>.total` (= `base` + `reward`). Token amounts are base-unit integer strings (1 USDC = `"1000000"`). `tvl.usd` and other USD values are decimal strings. Timestamps are Unix seconds. `score.vaultScore` is unrounded, in the range 0–100 (observed 27.5–99.1).
- Hidden defaults: `allowedNetworks` defaults to 4 networks (base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism) on `/v2/detailed-vaults` and the `/v2/portfolio/*` endpoints; pass every network you need. `minTvl` defaults to 100000 USD. `sortOrder` defaults to `asc`: send `sortOrder=desc` to rank best first.
- Array query params: repeat the key (`allowedNetworks=base&allowedNetworks=arbitrum`). A comma list returns 0 rows and no error. Unknown filter values return 200 with empty `data` and the value in `errors.unsupportedNetworks` (or `unsupportedAssets`, `unsupportedProtocols`).
- Pagination: `page` starts at 0; `perPage` default 50, max 5000 (historical 20000). `nextPage` is omitted, never null, on the last page: loop while the key is present. There is no total count.
- Positions: `asset.balanceNative` / `asset.balanceUsd` are the wallet's idle balance of the underlying token, repeated on every position. Position size is `asset.positionValueInAsset` (base units) or `lpToken.balanceUsd`. Never sum `asset.balanceUsd` across positions.
- Transactions are unsigned. Execute `actions[]` in order, waiting for each receipt. `tx.value` is omitted for ERC-20 flows (treat it as 0). The API does no balance check and no simulation (`simulate` is ignored). Before signing, verify chain, target, amount and approvals and get human confirmation: [Transaction safety](https://docs.vaults.fyi/ai-agents/transaction-safety.md).
- Credits: every call costs credits (for example `/v2/detailed-vaults` = 1 + 3 per vault returned); pay-as-you-go is $0.002 per credit ([Credits](https://docs.vaults.fyi/plans/credits.md)). On 429, 503 or 504 back off using `x-ratelimit-reset` or `retry-after`; on 400, fix the request ([Errors](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/errors.md)).

## Start here

- [vaults.fyi: the API for DeFi yield](https://docs.vaults.fyi/introduction.md): Start here: what the vaults.fyi REST API covers, the base URL and x-api-key header, the defaults that silently narrow results …
- [vaults.fyi REST API overview](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/overview.md): Start here for the vaults.fyi REST API: base URL, x-api-key auth, a first working request, units, pagination, defaults …
- [Rules for agents using vaults.fyi](https://docs.vaults.fyi/ai-agents/rules-for-agents.md): Compact, imperative rules for LLM agents calling the vaults.fyi REST API or MCP server …

## Conventions and errors

- [API conventions: units, identifiers, defaults and pagination](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/conventions.md): Rules every vaults.fyi endpoint shares: APY and amount units, timestamps, network and vault identifiers, the 4-network default scope, array params …
- [Errors, rate limits and retries](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/errors.md): Every HTTP status the vaults.fyi API returns, with real error bodies, rate-limit headers, which errors to retry, copy-paste backoff code …
- [Versioning and stability: v2, beta and alpha](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/versioning.md): What the v2, beta and alpha path prefixes promise, what may change without notice, the current deprecation practice …

## OpenAPI specs

- [v2 OpenAPI spec (stable, 35 operations)](https://api.vaults.fyi/v2/documentation/json): machine-readable source for paths and parameters; use for codegen and tool definitions
- [beta OpenAPI spec (32 operations)](https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/documentation/json): Solana, borrow markets, The Deep, Pendle fixed term, advanced analytics, partial returns; may change
- [alpha OpenAPI spec (11 operations)](https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/documentation/json): cross-chain intents, CCTP bridge, holders, historical positions and flows; may change without notice

- [Recipe: 90 days of daily APY and comparison with the USD benchmark](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/vault-history-vs-benchmark.md): Executed recipe: fetch daily 7-day APY for the last 90 days with granularity=1day and Unix-second timestamps …
- [Recipe: wallet positions with correct balance math](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/positions-and-balances.md): Executed recipe: list a wallet's vault positions with GET /v2/portfolio/positions/{userAddress}, convert asset.positionValueInAsset from base units …
- [Recipe: build, verify and sign a vault deposit (EVM)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/deposit-transaction.md): Executed recipe: read GET /v2/transactions/context/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}…
- [Recipe: withdraw from instant and queued vaults (redeem, request-redeem, claim-redeem)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/redeem-and-queued-withdrawal.md): Executed recipe: read currentRedeemStep from the transaction context, build redeem with all=true for instant vaults or request-redeem then …
- [Recipe: claim every pending reward for a wallet](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/claim-rewards.md): Executed recipe: read GET /v2/transactions/rewards/context/{userAddress} (claimable is an object keyed by network)…
- [Recipe: near-real-time share price for a deposit preview](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/near-real-time-share-price.md): Executed recipe: read sharePrice, totalAssets, totalSupply and underlyingAssetPrice from GET /v2/nrt/vault/{network}/{vaultId}…
- [Recipe: handle errors, soft errors and rate limits (402, 401, 400, 429)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/handle-errors-and-retries.md): Executed recipe: a small client wrapper that branches on HTTP status, explains 402 without a key vs 401 invalid key vs 403 credits exhausted …
- [Recipe: estimate the credit cost of a workload (hourly dashboard example)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/estimate-credit-cost.md): Executed recipe: compute vaults.fyi credits from the published base and per-item costs, price a real call from itemsOnPage …
- [Recipe: map network names and chain IDs, and find a vaultId](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/network-and-vault-ids.md): Executed recipe: resolve user input such as "Ethereum" or "chain 8453" to API network values (mainnet, base or CAIP-2) with GET /v2/networks …
- [Recipe: TVL attribution suffix for calldata you build yourself](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/tvl-attribution-suffix.md): Executed recipe: get the attribution suffix from GET /v2/transactions/suffix/{userAddress}/{vaultId}…
- [Recipe: Solana (SVM) vault deposit payload (Beta)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/recipes/solana-deposit.md): Executed recipe: build an unsigned Solana deposit with the Beta /beta/svm/transactions/{action}/{userAddress}/{vaultAddress} endpoints …

## Concepts and methodology

- [Vault discovery: detailed-vault fields](https://docs.vaults.fyi/concepts/vault-discovery.md): Field-by-field reference for vault objects from GET /v2/detailed-vaults and GET /v2/detailed-vaults/{network}/{vaultId}…
- [Yield and market data](https://docs.vaults.fyi/concepts/yield-and-market-data.md): Which endpoint gives which vault data (list, single vault, APY, TVL, history, benchmarks, NRT), with units, defaults …
- [Portfolio tracking](https://docs.vaults.fyi/concepts/portfolio-tracking.md): Read a wallet's vault positions, idle tokens, returns, events and deposit suggestions from /v2/portfolio/* …
- [Transaction flows](https://docs.vaults.fyi/concepts/transaction-flows.md): Build unsigned vault transactions: GET /v2/transactions/context/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}…
- [TVL attribution](https://docs.vaults.fyi/concepts/tvl-attribution.md): Attribute vault deposits and withdrawals to your app: payloads from /v2/transactions/* already carry the suffix …
- [Supported protocols and networks](https://docs.vaults.fyi/concepts/supported-protocols.md): Which protocols and EVM networks vaults.fyi covers, the exact network slugs and CAIP-2 ids the API accepts …
- [Borrowing (Beta)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/concepts/borrowing.md): Beta borrow-market API: list markets, read a wallet's supplied/borrowed positions and health factor, and build unsigned supply, withdraw …
- [How vaults.fyi calculates APY](https://docs.vaults.fyi/methodology/calculating-apy.md): APY method and API representation: realized share-price APY, net of fees, decimal fraction, five windows (1hour–90day), base vs reward …
- [Reputation Score](https://docs.vaults.fyi/methodology/reputation-score.md): What score.vaultScore measures, its four weighted components and their response fields, flag penalties …
- [Benchmark rates](https://docs.vaults.fyi/methodology/benchmark-rates.md): How vaults.fyi USD and ETH benchmark rates are built and how to fetch them: GET /v2/benchmarks/{network}?code=usd|eth …
- [Indexing onchain data](https://docs.vaults.fyi/methodology/indexing-onchain-data.md): How vaults.fyi reads vault state from chain every hour, how share price is derived per vault type (ERC-4626, rebasing, LST, staking, RWA)…

## API reference: general

- [General: vaults, assets, networks, protocols, curators and tags](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/general.md): Index of the cheap v2 reference-data endpoints (1 credit each): vault IDs on all networks, assets with decimals, networks, protocols …
- [List vault identifiers on all networks (cheap)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/general/list-vaults.md): `GET /v2/vaults`; 1 credit; vault IDs, names and assets on all networks; no APY/TVL
- [List supported assets with address, decimals and CAIP-19](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/general/list-assets.md): `GET /v2/assets`; 1 credit; token address, decimals and CAIP-19 per network
- [List supported EVM networks (name, chainId, CAIP-2)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/general/list-networks.md): `GET /v2/networks`; 1 credit; the 22 network names, chain IDs and CAIP-2 IDs
- [List protocols and protocol IDs for protocol filters](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/general/list-protocols.md): `GET /v2/protocols`; 1 credit; protocol names and `protocolId` values for filters
- [List vault curators for the curators filter](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/general/list-curators.md): `GET /v2/curators`; 1 credit; curator names for the `curators` filter
- [List vault tags accepted by the tags filter](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/general/list-tags.md): `GET /v2/tags`; 1 credit; valid values for the `tags` filter

## API reference: detailed vaults

- [Detailed vaults: rank, filter and inspect vaults](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/detailed-vaults.md): Index of the v2 detailed-vault endpoints: rank and filter vaults by APY, TVL and Reputation Score (1 + 3 credits per vault), or fetch one vault …
- [Search, filter and rank vaults with APY, TVL and score](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/detailed-vaults/list-detailed-vaults.md): `GET /v2/detailed-vaults`; 1 credit + 3/vault; search, filter and rank vaults; 4-network default, `minTvl` 100000, `sortOrder` asc
- [Get full analytics for one vault](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/detailed-vaults/get-vault-details.md): `GET /v2/detailed-vaults/{network}/{vaultId}`; 3 credits; full analytics for one vault
- [Get one vault's current APY (cheapest)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/detailed-vaults/get-vault-apy.md): `GET /v2/detailed-vaults/{network}/{vaultId}/apy`; 1 credit; current APY windows of one vault (cheapest APY read)
- [Get one vault's current TVL](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/detailed-vaults/get-vault-tvl.md): `GET /v2/detailed-vaults/{network}/{vaultId}/tvl`; 1 credit; current TVL of one vault

## API reference: historical

- [Historical: APY, TVL, share-price and asset-price time series](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical.md): Index of the v2 historical endpoints (oldest-first time series, Unix-seconds windows, perPage up to 20000) for vault APY, TVL …
- [Get one vault's APY, TVL and share-price history](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical/get-vault-historical-data.md): `GET /v2/historical/{network}/{vaultId}`; 3 credits + 3/data point; APY, TVL and share price series in one call
- [Get one vault's APY history](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical/get-historical-apy.md): `GET /v2/historical/{network}/{vaultId}/apy`; 1 credit + 1/data point; APY series; `granularity`, `apyInterval`, Unix-second window, oldest first
- [Get one vault's TVL history](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical/get-historical-tvl.md): `GET /v2/historical/{network}/{vaultId}/tvl`; 1 credit + 1/data point; TVL series, oldest first
- [Get one vault's share-price history](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical/get-historical-share-price.md): `GET /v2/historical/{network}/{vaultId}/sharePrice`; 1 credit + 1/data point; share-price series, oldest first
- [Get USD price history of one asset](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical/get-historical-asset-prices.md): `GET /v2/historical/asset-prices/{network}/{assetAddress}`; 1 credit + 1/data point; USD price series of one token

## API reference: benchmarks

- [Benchmarks: USD and ETH benchmark APY](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/benchmarks.md): Index of the v2 benchmark endpoints: current and historical vaults.fyi benchmark APY for USD (code=usd) or ETH (code=eth) strategies on a network …
- [Get the current USD or ETH benchmark APY on a network](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/benchmarks/get-benchmark-rate.md): `GET /v2/benchmarks/{network}`; 3 credits; current USD or ETH benchmark APY (`code` required)
- [Get benchmark APY history for a network](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/benchmarks/get-historical-benchmarks.md): `GET /v2/historical-benchmarks/{network}`; 3 credits + 3/data point; benchmark APY series

## API reference: portfolio

- [Portfolio: positions, idle assets, returns and deposit suggestions](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio.md): Index of the v2 wallet endpoints …
- [List a wallet's vault positions](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/list-portfolio-positions.md): `GET /v2/portfolio/positions/{userAddress}`; 5 credits; a wallet's vault positions; size = `positionValueInAsset`, not `balanceNative`
- [Get a wallet's position in one vault](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/get-portfolio-position.md): `GET /v2/portfolio/positions/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`; 1 credit; a wallet's position in one vault
- [List a wallet's undeposited token balances](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/list-idle-assets.md): `GET /v2/portfolio/idle-assets/{userAddress}`; 5 credits; a wallet's tokens not deposited in vaults
- [Rank deposit options for each asset a wallet holds](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/get-best-deposit-options.md): `GET /v2/portfolio/best-deposit-options/{userAddress}`; 1 credit + 2/vault; depositable vaults per idle token
- [Get the single best vault for a wallet's largest asset](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/get-best-vault.md): `GET /v2/portfolio/best-vault/{userAddress}`; 2 credits; single best vault for the wallet's largest asset
- [Get a wallet's lifetime returns in one vault](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/get-total-returns.md): `GET /v2/portfolio/total-returns/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`; 1 credit; lifetime returns of a wallet in one vault
- [List a wallet's deposits and withdrawals in one vault](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/list-position-events.md): `GET /v2/portfolio/events/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`; 3 credits; deposit and withdrawal events of a wallet in one vault

## API reference: transactions

- [Transactions: unsigned deposit, redeem and reward-claim payloads](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/transactions.md): Index of the v2 transaction endpoints: context first, then unsigned ordered actions for deposit, redeem and reward claims …
- [Get balances and next steps before a vault transaction](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/transactions/get-transaction-context.md): `GET /v2/transactions/context/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`; 3 credits; call first: steps, decimals, balances, pending requests
- [Build unsigned vault transactions (deposit, redeem, claim)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/transactions/get-transaction-payload.md): `GET /v2/transactions/{action}/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`; 5 credits; unsigned ordered `actions[]` for deposit, redeem, request/claim
- [List a wallet's claimable rewards by network](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/transactions/get-rewards-context.md): `GET /v2/transactions/rewards/context/{userAddress}`; 3 credits; claimable rewards keyed by network, with `claimId`
- [Build unsigned reward-claim transactions](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/transactions/claim-rewards.md): `GET /v2/transactions/rewards/claim/{userAddress}`; 5 credits; unsigned claim transactions for repeated `claimIds`
- [Get the attribution calldata suffix for your API key](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/transactions/get-transaction-suffix.md): `GET /v2/transactions/suffix/{userAddress}/{vaultId}`; 1 credit; attribution suffix for calldata you build yourself

## API reference: near real-time (NRT)

- [Near real-time (NRT): live vault share price, assets and supply](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/nrt.md): Index of the v2 NRT endpoints that read a vault's share price, total assets, total supply and underlying price live from chain …
- [Get live on-chain share price, supply and assets of a vault](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/nrt/get-vault-nrt-data.md): `GET /v2/nrt/vault/{network}/{vaultId}`; 1 credit; live share price, total assets and supply read from chain
- [Get a vault's live share price](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/nrt/get-vault-nrt-share-price.md): `GET /v2/nrt/vault/{network}/{vaultId}/sharePrice`; 1 credit; live share price only
- [Get a vault's live total assets](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/nrt/get-vault-nrt-total-assets.md): `GET /v2/nrt/vault/{network}/{vaultId}/totalAssets`; 1 credit; live total assets only (base units)
- [Get a vault's live total share supply](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/nrt/get-vault-nrt-total-supply.md): `GET /v2/nrt/vault/{network}/{vaultId}/totalSupply`; 1 credit; live total share supply only (base units)
- [Get the live USD price of a vault's underlying asset](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/nrt/get-vault-nrt-underlying-asset-price.md): `GET /v2/nrt/vault/{network}/{vaultId}/underlyingAssetPrice`; 1 credit; live USD price of the underlying token

- [Health check (public, no API key)](https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/health/health-check.md): `GET /v2/health`; public, no key; public liveness check; does not validate your key

## Use cases

- [Why use vaults.fyi](https://docs.vaults.fyi/why-vaultsfyi.md): Decide whether vaults.fyi fits your product: what it replaces, who uses it, which capabilities are GA (v2) vs Beta …
- [Embed Yield and Borrowing in Wallets and Consumer Apps](https://docs.vaults.fyi/use-cases/for-wallets-and-apps.md): Give users earn and borrow features with the data, risk context, transaction payloads, portfolio tracking, attribution, and fee logic your team needs.
